The '''OKC-167 repulsor pack''' was a natural progression from other primitive personal flight devices. It had modern microrepulsorlifts powered by six [[Power cell/Legends|power packs]] and allowed both forward flight and hovering. It was not as popular with recreational users as [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] and did not find a wide following in the military.
